services.desc: Use this Seattle fishing charter season guide to see when salmon, lingcod and Dungeness crab are biting in Puget Sound so you can book the best time for your trip. Winter fishing in Puget Sound focuses on resident salmon and bottom fish and is a quieter time on the water around Seattle. Cool, calm days and lighter boat traffic make it a good option for anglers who don’t mind bundling up.
